title: Plans for HDB Commercial Shops with Near-expiry Leases
what_it_is: Plans for HDB Commercial Shops with Near-expiry Leases

sections.label: Renting shops after lease expiry
sections.summary: HDB can consider letting lessees rent shops after the lease expires, if in line with future planning intentions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Where possible and if in line with future planning intentions, HDB can consider allowing lessees to rent the shops after the lease expires.

sections.label: ROS scheme review and uptake
sections.summary: 50% of HDB Town Centres and Neighbourhood Centres have benefited from the ROS scheme, and MND and HDB are reviewing it.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: To-date, 50% of HDB Town Centres and Neighbourhood Centres have benefited from the ROS scheme.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: MND and HDB have also been reviewing the ROS scheme with the aim of encouraging more retailers to upgrade their shops and business operations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: The outcome of the review will be announced in due course.

sections.label: Sale versus lease shop mix
sections.summary: HDB does not sell any more shops, all are on rental basis, and it will look at each case case-by-case.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling
sentences.text: The second question is what are the criteria being used to determine the ratio in each of the HDB heartland, between those shops on sale and those for lease.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, I cannot give a definite answer but HDB will look at each case on a case-by-case basis.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: On the mix between sale and lease, HDB does not sell any more shops.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Currently, all the shops are put up on a rental basis.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: If it is within the tenure of the lease, HDB will consider it.
